subject: is it possible to simulate connected crosses ?

messages.author: 24e3b0f2bc6aee90
messages.subject: is it possible to simulate connected crosses ?
parts:
Dear Karl,
I want to simulate genetic data files for connected crosses (with parents common to some crosses; in my case, a half-diallel) to compare different strategies to obtain an integrated map. As I understand, sim.cross can simulate genetic data only for a single cross. Do you think that there would be any possibility to use it also to obtain simulated genetic data for connected crosses ?
Thank you in advance for your answer.
Agnes Doligez

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] is it possible to simulate connected crosses ?
parts:
You can simulate multiple crosses by calling it repeatedly. You'll need
to decide, or simulate, which markers are segregating in which cross.

karl
